name: NeoPixel Ring (12, 16, 24)
description: Ultra bright smart LED NeoPixels arranged in a circle. The rings are chainable - connect the output pin of one to the input pin of another. Use only one microcontroller pin to control as many as you can chain together. Each LED is addressable as the driver chip is inside the LED. Each one has ~18mA constant current drive so the color will be very consistent even if the voltage varies, and no external choke resistors are required making the design slim. Power the whole thing with 5VDC (4-7V works). Single data line with a timing-specific protocol requiring a real-time microcontroller such as an AVR, Arduino, etc.

name: BNO055 9-DOF Absolute Orientation Sensor Breakout
description: Bosch BNO055 smart 9-DOF sensor that does sensor fusion on-chip. Takes a MEMS accelerometer, magnetometer and gyroscope on a single die with a high speed ARM Cortex-M0 based processor to digest all the sensor data, abstract the sensor fusion and real time requirements away, and output data in quaternions, Euler angles or vectors. Includes SparkFun qwiic compatible STEMMA QT connectors for I2C. Rather than spending weeks fiddling with algorithms, you can have meaningful sensor data in minutes thanks to the BNO055.

name: INA219 High Side DC Current Sensor Breakout
description: INA219B chip measures both high side voltage and DC current draw over I2C with 1% precision. Handles high side current measuring up to +26VDC, even though powered with 3 or 5V. Also reports high side voltage for tracking battery life or solar panels. Precision amplifier measures voltage across 0.1 ohm 1% sense resistor. With internal 12 bit ADC, resolution at +/-3.2A range is 0.8mA. With internal gain at minimum div8, max current is +/-400mA with 0.1mA resolution. Advanced users can replace the sense resistor to change the range.

name: BME280 Temperature/Humidity/Pressure Sensor Breakout
description: Bosch BME280 environmental sensor with temperature, barometric pressure and humidity. Best low-cost sensing solution for measuring humidity with +/-3% accuracy, barometric pressure with +/-1 hPa absolute accuracy, and temperature with +/-1.0C accuracy. Can also be used as an altimeter with +/-1 meter or better accuracy. Next-generation upgrade to BMP085/BMP180/BMP183 with low altitude noise of 0.25m and fast conversion time. Supports both I2C and SPI interfaces.

name: MCP9808 High Accuracy I2C Temperature Sensor Breakout
description: I2C digital temperature sensor with typical accuracy of +/-0.25C over -40C to +125C range and precision of +0.0625C. Works with any microcontroller using standard I2C. 3 address pins allow up to 8 on a single I2C bus without address collisions. Wide voltage range 2.7V to 5.5V logic. Placed on a breakout board PCB with mounting holes and pull down resistors for address pins.

name: Feather M0 Basic Proto (SAMD21)
description: ATSAMD21G18 ARM Cortex M0 processor clocked at 48 MHz at 3.3V logic (same as Arduino Zero). 256K of FLASH and 32K of RAM. Built-in USB for USB-to-Serial program and debug capability with no need for an FTDI-like chip. Connector for 3.7V Lithium polymer batteries with built-in battery charging. Automatically switches between USB and battery power. Battery voltage divider on analog pin for monitoring. Feather form factor for portable projects.

name: Motor Shield V2 for Arduino
description: Upgraded motor shield using TB6612 MOSFET drivers with 1.2A per channel (3A peak for ~20ms). Much lower voltage drops than the original L293D darlington design, with built-in flyback diodes. Fully-dedicated PWM driver chip handles all motor and speed controls over I2C, requiring only SDA and SCL pins. Drives up to 4 DC motors or 2 stepper motors. Completely stackable: 5 address-select pins means up to 32 shields (64 steppers or 128 DC motors). Polarity protection FET on power pins and prototyping area included.

name: VS1053 Codec (MP3/WAV/MIDI/Ogg) Breakout
description: VLSI VS1053B DSP codec chip breakout. Decodes MP3, AAC, Ogg Vorbis, WMA, MIDI, FLAC, WAV (PCM and ADPCM). Can also record audio in PCM (WAV) and compressed Ogg Vorbis. Adjustable bass, treble, and volume digitally. 8 GPIO pins for LEDs or buttons. Lightweight SPI interface so nearly any microcontroller can play audio from SD card. Special MIDI mode reads classic 31250Kbaud MIDI data on UART pin and acts like a synth/drum machine with dozens of built-in drum and sample effects.

name: Si5351A Clock Generator Breakout
description: Si5351A I2C controller clock generator with precision 25MHz crystal reference and internal PLL and dividers. Generates frequencies from <8KHz up to 150+ MHz. Three independent outputs, each with a different frequency. Outputs are 3Vpp. Breakout includes 3.3V LDO regulator for 3-5VDC power and level shifting circuitry on I2C lines for 3V or 5V logic compatibility. Optional SMA connector for RF work.

name: MAX98357 I2S Class-D Mono Amp Breakout
description: All-in-one digital audio amp that takes standard I2S digital audio input, decodes it into analog, and amplifies directly into a speaker. Combines I2S DAC and amp into one breakout. Delivers 3.2 Watts into 4 ohm speaker (5V power at 10% THD). Class D controller runs from 2.7V-5.5VDC, incredibly efficient for portable and battery-powered projects. Built-in thermal and over-current protection.

name: Feather RP2040
description: Open source PCB for the Feather RP2040 in Feather form factor. Built around the Raspberry Pi RP2040 chip. Design has been built and tested successfully. PCB format is EagleCAD schematic and board layout. Released so folks can start creating custom designs based on the RP2040 chip.

name: Circuit Playground Express
description: Introduction to electronics and programming board. Programmable with Microsoft MakeCode (block-based or Javascript), CircuitPython, Arduino IDE, and code.org CS Discoveries. Round board with alligator-clip pads, no soldering required. Powers from USB, AAA battery pack, or LiPoly battery. Built-in USB support - plug in to program, shows up automatically. Same shape and size as original Circuit Playground Classic but with more sensors and easier programming.

name: MacroPad RP2040
description: 3x4 keyboard macropad powered by Raspberry Pi RP2040 with 8 MB flash. USB-C for power/data, can act as HID, MIDI, UART. 12 Cherry MX-compatible key switch sockets (individually tied to GPIO, not matrix wired) with one NeoPixel RGB LED per switch. Rotary encoder with 20 detents and push-switch. 128x64 SH1106 monochrome OLED on high speed hardware SPI. 8mm speaker/buzzer with Class D amplifier. STEMMA QT connector for I2C add-ons. Programmable with CircuitPython or Arduino. Dual core Cortex M0+ at ~130MHz with 264KB SRAM.

name: Feather ESP32-S3
description: ESP32-S3 in Feather format with dual 240 MHz cores, WiFi and BLE support, and native USB (keyboard, disk drive, MIDI). 8 MB flash, 512KB SRAM, no PSRAM. USB-C with built-in battery charging for LiPoly. LC709203 battery monitor for voltage and state of charge reporting over I2C. STEMMA QT connector with switchable power for low power mode. Deep sleep ~100uA from LiPoly connection. Works with ESP-IDF, Arduino, or CircuitPython. Compatible with 50+ Feather Wings.

name: HUZZAH32 ESP32 Feather
description: ESP32-based Feather using the official WROOM32 module with dual-core ESP32 chip, 4 MB SPI Flash, tuned antenna. Both WiFi and Bluetooth Classic/LE support. Built-in USB-to-Serial converter, automatic bootloader reset, Lithium Ion/Polymer charger. All GPIOs brought out for use with Feather Wings. Compared to ESP8266: more GPIO, plenty of analog inputs, two analog outputs, multiple extra peripherals (spare UART), two cores, higher-speed processor.

name: Grand Central M4 Express (SAMD51)
description: Arduino Mega form factor board with Microchip ATSAMD51P20: 120MHz Cortex M4 with floating point DSP, 1MB flash, 256KB RAM. 70 GPIO pins total, dual 1 MSPS DAC, dual 1 MSPS ADC (15 analog pins), 8x hardware SERCOM (I2C/SPI/UART), 22x PWM outputs, stereo I2S, 12-bit parallel capture controller (camera/video in), built-in AES-256 crypto, true RNG. 8 MB QSPI Flash, Micro SD card slot, NeoPixel. Power from 6-12V DC with on/off switch or micro USB. Native USB stack with UF2 bootloader. Compatible with Arduino and CircuitPython.

name: PyPortal - CircuitPython Powered Internet Display
description: IoT device with ATSAMD51J20 M4 processor and ESP32 Wi-Fi coprocessor with TLS/SSL support. 3.2 inch 320x240 color TFT with resistive touch screen. Includes speaker, light sensor, temperature sensor (ADT7410), NeoPixel, microSD card slot, 8MB flash, plug-in I2C and 2 analog/digital ports. SAMD51 handles native USB (disk drive, HID, MIDI, serial) and user interface while ESP32 handles WiFi/TLS/SSL. Python-powered using tinyJSON/APIs for IoT data. Also available as PyPortal Pynt (2.4 inch smaller version, no ADT7410).

name: Feather nRF52840 Sense (Bluefruit)
description: Feather nRF52840 with built-in sensor suite. Nordic nRF52840: ARM Cortex M4F at 64MHz with HW floating point, 1MB flash, 256KB SRAM, Bluetooth Low Energy. Native USB stack with UF2 bootloader. Sensors: LSM6DS33 Accel/Gyro + LIS3MDL magnetometer (9-DoF), APDS9960 proximity/light/color/gesture, PDM microphone, SHT humidity, BMP280 temperature/barometric pressure. 21 GPIO, 6x 12-bit ADC, up to 12 PWM outputs, FCC/IC/TELEC certified. Up to +8dBm output power. Works with Arduino IDE and CircuitPython with BLE support.

name: Metro M4 Express (SAMD51)
description: Arduino-compatible Metro form factor with Microchip ATSAMD51: 120MHz Cortex M4 with floating point support. Same size and shield-compatible as other Metros with analog pins, SPI/UART/I2C in standard positions. Compatible with all Arduino shields. Powered by ATSAMD51J19 processor.

name: CLUE nRF52840 Express
description: Sensor-packed development board in BBC micro:bit form factor with edge-connector and 5 big pads. Nordic nRF52840: 1MB Flash, 256KB RAM, 64MHz Cortex M4. 1.3 inch 240x240 Color IPS TFT display. Powers from 3-6V battery. Sensors: LSM6DS33 Accel/Gyro + LIS3MDL magnetometer (9-DoF), APDS9960 proximity/light/color/gesture, PDM microphone, SHT humidity, BMP280 temperature/barometric pressure/altitude. RGB NeoPixel, 2MB internal flash, buzzer/speaker, two white LEDs for illumination/color sensing. STEMMA QT / Qwiic connector for I2C add-ons. Programmable with Arduino IDE or CircuitPython.
